единицы.утверждение_en: In generative AI, grounding is the ability to connect model output to verifiable sources of information; giving models access to specific data sources tethers their output to these data and reduces the chances of inventing content.
единицы.цитата:
In generative AI, grounding is the ability to connect model output to verifiable
sources of information. If you provide models with access to specific data
sources, then grounding tethers their output to these data and reduces the
chances of inventing content.
единицы.заметка: Определение термина grounding в документации Google Cloud. Страница не упоминает изображения и image-модели; единица взята только как определение для темы grounding, без переноса на генерацию картинок.
